usage:
require "openai"

client = Openai::Client.new(api_key: ENV["OPENAI_API_KEY"])

result = client.admin.organization.groups.users.list("group_id", limit: 100, after: "after", order: "asc")
pp result

typeReference.signature: client.admin.organization.groups.users.list(group_id, limit: nil, after: nil, order: nil) -> Page<Models::GroupUser>

fields.name: limit
fields.description: A limit on the number of users to be returned. Limit can range between 0 and 1000, and the default is 100.

fields.name: after
fields.description: A cursor for use in pagination. Provide the ID of the last user from the previous list response to retrieve the next page.

fields.name: order
fields.description: Specifies the sort order of users in the list.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The identifier, which can be referenced in API endpoints

fields.name: email
fields.description: The email address of the user.
